comparison.objective: Join two loose-cord barrel connectors and lay the joined pair down; candidate breaks and removes insert tangs.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual coaxial connector mating within stated pose tolerances versus mandrel stabilization during hammer impact and post-fracture recovery.
comparison.success_condition: Plug fully inserted, connectors released on bench, arms returned, and nothing lost versus four tang fractures and containment with inserts unchanged.
comparison.reason: Both require fine coaxial alignment, but mating two parts tests insertion/seating, while the candidate tests contact-driven notch fracture and recovery of free fragments.
